name: roqam
description: ROQAM (Readout & Quick Access Mod): status bar for Claude Code (terminal and desktop app, Windows) with English labels: context, plan limits, cache, Anthropic status, model, version, chats, connectors; sky and weather at your location and streaming speed; buttons Save, Handoff, Compact, New, Rec (hides paths, costs and accounts, switches on by itself with OBS and similar).

location.title: Location for sky and weather
location.description: Name of a town or city, e.g. "London". Leave empty to hide sky and weather. Data from Open-Meteo and 7Timer, no account needed.

apiCost.title: Show API costs
apiCost.description: What the session and the plan month would have cost via the API (comparison value in USD).

higgsfield.title: Show Higgsfield credits
higgsfield.description: Shown automatically once the claude.ai connector "Higgsfield" is connected (also later on). false = never show.

promotions.title: Report new promotions from Anthropic
promotions.description: Shows "⚑ New promotion" when a promotion changes in ~/.claude.json (cloud credit, guest passes, discount, usage-limit notices). Clicking it shows what changed and hides the notice.

weatherUrl.title: Own weather station (address)
weatherUrl.description: Empty = temperature, dew point and humidity from Open-Meteo at your location. Otherwise the address of your own weather API (JSON with latest.temp.value, latest.dew_point.value, latest.hum.value).

newChatFolder.title: Folder for "+ New"
newChatFolder.description: Empty = new chat in the folder of the current chat. Otherwise always in this folder.
